title: Whole-year rotations gave no clear annual phase coherence in shallow M5.5+ earthquakes at 15-90 degrees in 2001-2025
abstract: We tested annual phase coherence in 6,391 shallow ComCat earthquakes of preferred magnitude at least 5.5 at absolute latitudes of at least 15 degrees in 2001-2025. The pooled first-harmonic amplitude was 2.99%. The independent-event test gave p = 0.239. A null that rotated whole years gave p = 0.902. In 2001-2012 and 2013-2025, independent-event p values were 5.46e-10 and 8.04e-6, but rotation p values were 0.227 and 0.123. The fitted peaks differed by 5.4 months. Thus the subset peaks did not give clear annual phase coherence under this null. Thinning, a magnitude 6 cut and a southern phase shift also gave no clear rotation signal. The result shows sensitivity to null assumptions. It does not prove a physical cause or the absence of regional seasonal effects. Short records, cross-year clusters, catalog changes and conditioning on yearly concentration limit inference. Code, source hashes, aggregate vectors, an independent scalar check and a figure are included. External event records are not bundled.
